resources_content_by_type.name: resources_content_by_type
resources_content_by_type.value:
("resources"."type" = 'article' and length(btrim("resources"."body")) > 0 and "resources"."body" is not null)
    or ("resources"."type" = 'document' and "resources"."file_key" is not null and "resources"."file_name" is not null and "resources"."file_mime_type" is not null)
    or ("resources"."type" = 'link' and "resources"."url" is not null)

shift_assignments_date_order.name: shift_assignments_date_order
shift_assignments_date_order.value: "shift_assignments"."end_date" is null or "shift_assignments"."end_date" >= "shift_assignments"."start_date" or "shift_assignments"."ended_reason" is not null
